card.name: Head noun inside a drug or product phrase
card.fires_on: Fires on the second or later word of a noun phrase that names a drug product, test or method, such as 'oral' in 'Nizatidine oral solution' or 'abnormalities' after 'liver function test'. It sits right before the phrase's last word or a following verb.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: A form word such as oral, for, solution or prefilled follows a drug or brand name.
modes.example: Nizatidine<< oral>> solution is indicated for pediatric patients 1

modes.label: Modifier noun in a clinical phrase
modes.description: A word inside a multiword medical term, such as abnormalities, drugs or control, just before the phrase ends.
modes.example: The recommended dosage modifications for VITRAKVI liver function test<< abnormalities>> are provided in Table 2.

card.plain: It lights up on the middle words of drug and test names, like the 'oral' in 'oral solution'.
